content:
{'text': 'CNN首席數據分析師Harry Enten周四強調一項新出爐的霍士新聞民調結果，顯示30歲以下選民對特朗普的支持度出現他所形容的「驚人」崩潰。', 'paragraph_context': 'CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten on Thursday highlighted new Fox News polling showing what he described as an “absolutely stunning” collapse in support for Donald Trump among voters under 30.'}

{'text': '「他們不再認為特朗普很酷。他已經不再那麼入時，」Enten為其分析開場，指出根據該民調，特朗普在年輕選民中的淨支持率已從2024年10月的正3個百分點跌至現在的負50個百分點。', 'paragraph_context': '“They no longer think that Trump is groovy. He’s no longer jiggy with it,” Enten teed up his analysis, noting that Trump’s net approval rating among younger voters has fallen from +3 percentage points in October 2024 to -50 now, according to the poll.'}

{'text': '「這是我們大家都會計的數，」Enten說。「在他曾經擁有正支持度的群體中下跌了53個百分點。實在令人震驚。」', 'paragraph_context': '“This is math we can all do,” said Enten. “53 points in the wrong direction amongst a group he was once positive with. It’s absolutely stunning.”'}

{'text': 'Enten認為，特朗普在經濟和通脹議題上的表現似乎是導致支持度下跌的主要原因。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump’s performance on the economy and inflation appears to be driving much of the decline, Enten argued.'}

{'text': '他指出，在2024年總統大選競選期間，30歲以下選民在經濟議題上以2個百分點的優勢支持特朗普而非其民主黨對手賀錦麗。但特朗普在該年齡群體中對該議題的淨支持率目前為負64個百分點。', 'paragraph_context': 'During the 2024 presidential election campaign, voters under 30 favored Trump over his Democratic rival Kamala Harris by 2 percentage points on the economy, he noted. But Trump’s net approval rating among the same age group on the issue now stands at -64 percentage points.'}

{'text': 'Enten同時強調他在通脹議題上形容為「令人瞠目」的数字，只有9%的年輕選民認同他處理該問題的方式，而高達91%表示不滿。', 'paragraph_context': 'Enten also highlighted what he called Trump’s “eye-popping” numbers on inflation, with just 9% of younger voters approving of his handling of the issue and 91% disapproving.'}

{'text': 'Enten說：「認為美國登月是造假的美国人比認同特朗普處理通脹表現的年輕選民比例還要多。這些数字是我在任何民調中、任何議題上、任何總統身上見過最差的之一。」', 'paragraph_context': '“There are more Americans who think that we faked the moon landing than the percentage of young voters who actually approve of the job that Trump is doing on inflation,” said Enten. “These numbers are some of the worst I have ever seen in any poll, on any issue for any president.”'}
